comment: European shops that sell loudspeaker drivers, read weekly by watch/prices.py. 'home' is the shop's front page (its robots.txt and sitemap are found from it; 'sitemaps' can name them directly; 'pages' lists product pages by hand for a shop without a sitemap; 'hubs' lists pages whose links lead to the product pages, such as a brand page — the front page is used when there is no sitemap). 'pack' (a sentence) marks a shop whose price is for a box of several drivers: the offer is listed but never counted as the lowest. 'delay_s' is the pause between requests to that shop (a Crawl-delay in robots.txt overrides it when longer). Add a shop as one more entry; remove one by deleting its entry. 'note' is shown with the shop's offers; 'login_prices' marks a shop whose better prices show only when logged in (the scan sees the public price; the logged-in price is read on David's computer, see capture/CHROME_CAPTURE.md). 'currency' is used when a page shows a price without saying its currency.

shops.name: SoundImports
shops.note: often the most expensive; no longer carries BlieSMa

shops.name: Audio-hi.fi
shops.note: the go-to distributor in Europe for BlieSMa

shops.name: Toutlehautparleur
shops.note: often the cheapest, but the good prices show only when logged in; its site also refuses automatic reading (HTTP 403), so it is checked on David’s computer

shops.name: Purifi (direct)
shops.pack: Purifi's own shop sells whole boxes: the price is for a box of several drivers, not one driver
